name: AdCP 3.2 Host header carries an unbracketed IPv6 literal (malformed authority) while the URL is clean (content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #adcp-rfc-9421-profile (@authority derived from the as-received Host header and canonicalized by the URL canonicalization algorithm; malformed authority → request_target_uri_malformed); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/031-malformed-host-authority.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. The URL is the valid bracketed form and the Signature is a real Ed25519 signature over the base computed from the URL authority [::1], so the Host header is the only fault. A verifier that derives @authority from the URL alone verifies it. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
